About The Role

Intetics Inc. is a global technology company providing custom software development, dedicated team building, software quality assessment, and digital solutions. GIS and LiDAR are among our key areas of expertise, and we work with large-scale spatial and 3D datasets for infrastructure and utility projects. We are looking for a Middle GIS Specialist to join our team and work on projects involving the processing and analysis of aerial LiDAR and point cloud data for utility and power infrastructure . The role focuses on processing, classifying, and validating LiDAR data, as well as extracting and modeling utility assets such as power lines, conductors, poles, towers, vegetation, and ground features. Requirements 1–4 years of experience with LiDAR / point cloud processing. Hands-on experience with point cloud classification and QA/QC. Experience working with 3D spatial data. Experience with feature extraction from LiDAR data. Strong attention to detail and ability to identify data-quality issues. Basic/intermediate GIS knowledge. Nice to Have Experience with utility, power transmission, or distribution data. Experience with aerial LiDAR. Experience working with conductors, poles/towers, vegetation, and ground classes. Understanding of conductor/catenary modeling and clearance analysis. Experience with PLS-CADD, TerraSolid/TerraScan, or MicroStation. Experience with utility asset modeling or powerline mapping.

About The Role

At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future. Department Summary: MITRE’s Model-Based Analytics Department (L144) is looking for qualified applicants to bring their geospatial, machine learning, advanced analytics, and applied research skills to bear on solving problems of critical national importance. MITRE’s diverse work program provides opportunities to apply your expertise and creative thinking in challenging domains such as healthcare, transportation, and national security. Employees may also participate in MITRE’s internal research and development program, which provides funding for innovative applied research that addresses our sponsors’ hardest problems. Our department is an interdisciplinary department that thrives on having a large toolbox to support data- and model-driven decision making. We value people who can bring diverse and inclusive perspectives. Our department works to solve modeling and analytic problems in the public interest, in partnership with the government. We also actively conduct independent research in areas of interest to our government partners. If you are passionate about being a Data Scientist that specializes in Geospatial Information Sciences, your skill sets align with our capabilities, and you like working in a collaborative, team-oriented environment, we want to hear from you! Roles & Responsibilities: The successful candidate for this position is a geospatial data scientist who combines a solid theoretical and technical background with the ability to formulate problems, develop and evaluate solutions, and communicate results. Familiarity with advanced geospatial data science, modeling, and analysis techniques and methods (e.g., supervised and unsupervised machine learning, GeoAI, Geosimulation, patiotemporal graphs) is a plus. Hands-on software development skills are a must. Candidates should have a strong understanding of how to engineer spatial solutions for geospatial systems and architecture in both traditional and cloud computing environments. Lifelong learning and keeping up with the latest research and technologies is an essential part of working in this field. Roles and responsibilities include: Support the development of geospatial data science, modeling, analysis, visualization, and engineering deliverables for sponsor projects and programs, internal research and development, and corporate strategic initiatives. Remain current on open-source, industry, academia, and US Government techniques and tools for geospatial data science, modeling, analysis, visualization, and engineering. Apply a variety of spatial data science techniques to tackle customer challenges to include geospatial statistics, spatial optimization, spatial pattern analysis, geospatial artificial intelligence, spatial autocorrelation, activity-based intelligence, imagery analysis, remote sensing, and geospatial data visualization approaches. Build and test geospatial prototypes in MITRE, government, and commercial cloud environments. Basic Qualifications: Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 3 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with relevant experience who can immediately contribute at this job step; or equivalent combination of related education and work experience. Bachelor’s degree in Geospatial Data Science, Geospatial Intelligence, Geographic Information Systems, GeoInformatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or related degree. Applied experience with common GIS tools, developing geospatial workflows, and visualizations using Python. Applied experience in spatial analysis and modeling, and ETL of spatiotemporal datasets and managing spatial databases. Applied experience in the configuration of web-mapping, dashboard applications, and remotely sensed data. Familiarity with geostatistics, spatial machine learning, geosimulation, or GeoAI, and multispectral and hyperspectral imagery or synthetic aperture radar. Familiarity working with spatiotemporal data in graph databases, such as ArcGIS Knowledge, Neo4j, or ArangoDB. Familiarity developing web applications with common libraries, e.g. OpenLayers, Leaflet, ArcGIS JS API. Familiarity with geospatial data architectures and spatial database design and management, as well as containerization concepts. Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Top Secret/SCI U.S Government issued Security Clearance. Per the U.S. Government’s eligibility requirements, you must be a U.S Citizen to be considered for a security clearance. This position requires a minimum of 3 days on-site. Preferred Qualifications: Active TS/SCI with polygraph. Advanced degree in Geospatial Data Science, Geospatial Intelligence, Geographic Information Systems, GeoInformatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or related technical discipline. Experience leading technical development across multi-disciplinary teams. Applied experience with other software development languages, e.g., C++, Java, C#, JavaScript. Applied experience with spatiotemporal big data technologies, e.g., GeoMesa, GeoTrellis, Data Bricks, or GeoSpark (Apache Sedona). Applied experience with data architecture containerization concepts, e.g. Docker or Kubernetes. Applied experience working with remotely sensed data to include aerial and satellite imagery, multi- and hyper-spectral imagery, LiDAR, or synthetic aperture radar. Applied experience with applying spatial modeling and analysis techniques to the atmospheric, climate, marine, oceanic, hydrologic, geomorphologic, critical infrastructure, transportation, network, telemetry, or terrain domains. Experience leading or conducting research. Experience designing geospatial data science tasking and/or leading a team of geospatial data scientists. Applied experience with developing web applications with common libraries, e.g., OpenLayers, Leaflet, ArcGIS JS API. Familiarity implementing DevSecOps, DataOps, or Applied experience in architecting, resourcing, deploying, and administering a GID enterprise including physical and virtual machines, cloud-based components, and remote application delivery serving hundreds of users Applied experience maintaining multiple enterprise relations database management systems hosted in MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle or similar. About The Role

At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future. Department Summary: MITRE’s Model-Based Analytics Department (L144) is looking for qualified applicants to bring their geospatial, machine learning, advanced analytics, and applied research skills to bear on solving problems of critical national importance. MITRE’s diverse work program provides opportunities to apply your expertise and creative thinking in challenging domains such as healthcare, transportation, and national security. Employees may also participate in MITRE’s internal research and development program, which provides funding for innovative applied research that addresses our sponsors’ hardest problems. Our department is an interdisciplinary department that thrives on having a large toolbox to support data- and model-driven decision making. We value people who can bring diverse and inclusive perspectives. Our department works to solve modeling and analytic problems in the public interest, in partnership with the government. We also actively conduct independent research in areas of interest to our government partners. If you are passionate about being a Data Scientist that specializes in Geospatial Information Sciences, your skill sets align with our capabilities, and you like working in a collaborative, team-oriented environment, we want to hear from you! Roles & Responsibilities: The successful candidate for this position is a geospatial data scientist who combines a solid theoretical and technical background with the ability to formulate problems, develop and evaluate solutions, and communicate results. Familiarity with advanced geospatial data science, modeling, and analysis techniques and methods (e.g., supervised and unsupervised machine learning, GeoAI, Geosimulation, patiotemporal graphs) is a plus. Hands-on software development skills are a must. Candidates should have a strong understanding of how to engineer spatial solutions for geospatial systems and architecture in both traditional and cloud computing environments. Lifelong learning and keeping up with the latest research and technologies is an essential part of working in this field. Roles and responsibilities include: Support the development of geospatial data science, modeling, analysis, visualization, and engineering deliverables for sponsor projects and programs, internal research and development, and corporate strategic initiatives. Remain current on open-source, industry, academia, and US Government techniques and tools for geospatial data science, modeling, analysis, visualization, and engineering. Apply a variety of spatial data science techniques to tackle customer challenges to include geospatial statistics, spatial optimization, spatial pattern analysis, geospatial artificial intelligence, spatial autocorrelation, activity-based intelligence, imagery analysis, remote sensing, and geospatial data visualization approaches. Build and test geospatial prototypes in MITRE, government, and commercial cloud environments. Basic Qualifications: Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 3 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with relevant experience who can immediately contribute at this job step; or equivalent combination of related education and work experience. Bachelor’s degree in Geospatial Data Science, Geospatial Intelligence, Geographic Information Systems, GeoInformatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or related degree. Applied experience with common GIS tools, developing geospatial workflows, and visualizations using Python. Applied experience in spatial analysis and modeling, and ETL of spatiotemporal datasets and managing spatial databases. Applied experience in the configuration of web-mapping, dashboard applications, and remotely sensed data. Familiarity with geostatistics, spatial machine learning, geosimulation, or GeoAI, and multispectral and hyperspectral imagery or synthetic aperture radar. Familiarity working with spatiotemporal data in graph databases, such as ArcGIS Knowledge, Neo4j, or ArangoDB. Familiarity developing web applications with common libraries, e.g. OpenLayers, Leaflet, ArcGIS JS API. Familiarity with geospatial data architectures and spatial database design and management, as well as containerization concepts. Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Top Secret/SCI U.S Government issued Security Clearance. Per the U.S. Government’s eligibility requirements, you must be a U.S Citizen to be considered for a security clearance. This position requires a minimum of 3 days on-site. Preferred Qualifications: Active TS/SCI with polygraph. Advanced degree in Geospatial Data Science, Geospatial Intelligence, Geographic Information Systems, GeoInformatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or related technical discipline. Experience leading technical development across multi-disciplinary teams. Applied experience with other software development languages, e.g., C++, Java, C#, JavaScript. Applied experience with spatiotemporal big data technologies, e.g., GeoMesa, GeoTrellis, Data Bricks, or GeoSpark (Apache Sedona). Applied experience with data architecture containerization concepts, e.g. Docker or Kubernetes. Applied experience working with remotely sensed data to include aerial and satellite imagery, multi- and hyper-spectral imagery, LiDAR, or synthetic aperture radar. Applied experience with applying spatial modeling and analysis techniques to the atmospheric, climate, marine, oceanic, hydrologic, geomorphologic, critical infrastructure, transportation, network, telemetry, or terrain domains. Experience leading or conducting research. Experience designing geospatial data science tasking and/or leading a team of geospatial data scientists. Applied experience with developing web applications with common libraries, e.g., OpenLayers, Leaflet, ArcGIS JS API. Familiarity implementing DevSecOps, DataOps, or Applied experience in architecting, resourcing, deploying, and administering a GID enterprise including physical and virtual machines, cloud-based components, and remote application delivery serving hundreds of users Applied experience maintaining multiple enterprise relations database management systems hosted in MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle or similar. This requisition requires the candidate to have a minimum of the following clearance(s): None This requisition requires the hired candidate to have or obtain, within one year from the date of hire, the following clearance(s): Top Secret/SCI Salary compensation range and midpoint: $124,400 - $155,500 - $186,600 Annual Work Location Type: Onsite Commitment to Non-Discrimination All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local or international law. About the role:

The Environmental and Social (E&S) Manager is responsible for ensuring that ACWA and assets in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia comply with applicable Saudi environmental, labor, occupational health and safety, and social requirements, as well as international lender standards. The role focuses on minimizing environmental impacts, managing social risks, maintaining regulatory compliance, and supporting sustainable project delivery in alignment with Saudi Vision 2030.

This is a project-critical role, particularly because ACWA projects may be subject to the requirements of Saudi authorities, including (NCEC), the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA), the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development (MHRSD), and other relevant regulators, in addition to international financing institutions such as IFC, EBRD, ECAs, and Equator Principles financial institutions.
Duties and responsibilities

Ensure compliance with Saudi environmental regulations and applicable international lender standards, including IFC Performance Standards, EBRD requirements, and Equator Principles expectations
Implement, maintain, and continuously improve the project Environmental and Social Management System (ESMS)
Manage environmental permits, approvals, renewals, and regulatory submissions with relevant Saudi authorities, including NCEC and other competent agencies as applicable
Monitor environmental impacts (air, water, waste, noise, biodiversity)
Oversee contractor E&S performance (EPC and O&M)
Conduct site inspections, audits, and walkovers
Stop non‑compliant or unsafe activities and ensure corrective actions
Lead stakeholder engagement activities with local communities, authorities, contractors, and project stakeholders in accordance with the project Stakeholder Engagement Plan
Operate and manage the grievance mechanism (communities & workers)
Prepare clear and timely E&S reports for lenders, Saudi regulators, project leadership, and external audits
Advise project leadership on E&S risks and improvements
Deliver E&S training and awareness to staff and contractors

Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Engineering, Sustainability, Social Sciences, or related field
10+ years experience in environmental & social management
4+ years site‑based experience on energy, infrastructure, or construction projects
Strong knowledge of:

IFC Performance Standards
IFC Performance Standards, EBRD requirements, Equator Principles, and international lender E&S reporting expectations
Saudi environmental, labor, occupational health and safety, permitting, and social compliance requirements
Experience implementing and managing Environmental & Social Management Systems (ESMS)
Proven experience working with international lenders and audits
Ability to manage contractors (EPC/O&M) and site compliance
Experience with stakeholder engagement and grievance mechanisms
Strong reporting, documentation, and risk‑management skills
Fluent English is required; Arabic language capability is highly desirable for engagement with Saudi authorities, contractors, and local stakeholders
Ability to communicate effectively with regulators, communities, and senior management
